card.name: Conditioning before stem cell transplant
card.fires_on: The word "conditioning" right after "reduced intensity" in gene-therapy or transplant labels. Also the middle of "Busulfan" in transplant regimen text.

modes.label: Conditioning regimen
modes.description: The word conditioning after "reduced intensity", before an infusion or a list of complications.
modes.example: Administer busulfan and fludarabine for reduced intensity<< conditioning>> before infusion of WASKYRA ®
